subject: general
question: In which city of India, did Dr. K. Kasturirangan, former Chairman of ISRO, inaugurate the Human Space Flight Centre in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is **Bangalore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. K. Kasturirangan**, former Chairman of ISRO, inaugurated the Human Space Flight Centre in Bangalore in 2019.
 
• The **Human Space Flight Centre** is responsible for the implementation of the Gaganyaan mission.
 
• The centre is located within the ISRO headquarters in **Bangalore**.
 
• The inauguration marks a significant step towards India's first manned space mission.
 
• The **Gaganyaan mission** aims to send Indian astronauts to space by 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **ISRO**
 **Indian Space Research Organisation**, the space agency of the Government of India, headquartered in Bangalore.
 
 

 **Gaganyaan Mission**
 India's first manned space mission, aiming to send Indian astronauts to space by 2022.
 
 

 **Human Space Flight Centre**
 The centre responsible for the implementation of the Gaganyaan mission, located in Bangalore.
 
 

 **Dr. K. Kasturirangan**
 Former Chairman of ISRO, known for his contributions to the Indian space program.
